findings.title: PlatoOverviewCallout connector tick clipped by overflow:hidden on Styled.Card
findings.spec_requirement: The card has a connector tick below it (a 4px-wide, 24px-tall divider line, matching the feed connector pattern in Styled.Event ::after pseudo-element at JobApplicationActivity.tsx lines 671-681).
findings.evidence: PlatoOverviewCallout.tsx Styled.Card has overflow: hidden (to contain the absolutely-positioned gradient bar). The connector tick is a ::after pseudo-element at top: 100%. overflow: hidden clips anything outside the element bounds, making the tick invisible. The analog (Styled.Event in JobApplicationActivity.tsx) uses position: relative without overflow: hidden.
findings.recommendation: Remove overflow: hidden from Styled.Card. Contain Styled.Bar by giving it matching border-radius for the left corners, or use an inner wrapper with overflow:hidden for the bar while keeping the card unclipped.

dismissed.title: Header Regenerate replaced by Buy credits when zero credits
dismissed.reason: Spec line 87 says 'When credits are zero and a generate action would be shown, show the existing buy-credits pattern.' Regenerate IS a generate action (it triggers useGenerateAiSummary). The phrase 'a generate action would be shown' is not limited to Empty/Failed states. Removing this guard would reintroduce Layer 2 code-correctness bug l2-001 where clicking Regenerate with zero credits hits a backend rejection with no useful error path.

dismissed.title: onOpen uses match.url.replace() instead of spec's match.url/ai
dismissed.reason: The spec says 'Use history.push(`${match.url}/ai`)' but this is a spec bug. JobApplicationActivity is rendered at the /overview Route, so match.url is '.../applicants/123/overview'. Using ${match.url}/ai produces '.../applicants/123/overview/ai' which is a non-existent route. The implementation correctly strips the last segment with match.url.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, '') to get '.../applicants/123' then navigates to '.../applicants/123/ai'. The implementation is correct; the spec is wrong.

user_directed_overrides: Spec section 4 says import FeatureFlipper/useFeatureFlipper/Features, wrap Route in FeatureFlipper, make possiblePaths conditional. User explicitly overrode: Route is unconditional, possiblePaths is static ['overview', 'resume', 'messages', 'files', 'notes', 'ai'], no FeatureFlipper imports in JobApplicationContainer. Matches AccountIntegrationsContainer pattern where only NavItems are gated.
